name: bitsql
description: SQL Server emulator for tests: start it in-process (WebAssembly) and connect with tedious or mssql over TDS
author: Mirek Rusin

scripts.build: cd ../.. && moon build --target wasm-gc --release src/wasm && cp _build/wasm-gc/release/build/wasm/wasm.wasm npm/bitsql/bitsql.wasm && cd npm/bitsql && tsc -p . && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module nodenext --types node test/types.ts
